```{r}
install.packages("ncdf4")  # only once
library(ncdf4)


nc_data <- nc_open(slr_file)

print("\nVARIABLES:")
for (var_name in names(nc_data$var)) {
  var_obj <- nc_data$var[[var_name]]
  print(paste("  ", var_name))
  print(paste("    Dimensions:", paste(names(var_obj$dim), collapse = " x ")))
  print(paste("    Units:", var_obj$units))
  print(paste("    Long name:", var_obj$longname))
}
```

```{r}

# Combined SLR mapping - AIS + GIS + glaciers + oceandynamics
library(sf)
library(raster)
library(ncdf4)
library(dplyr)

# Load AIS (Antarctic Ice Sheet)
nc1 <- nc_open("C:/Users/mk616/Documents/climate_plus_summer_2025_backup/AIS_ssp245_medium_confidence_values.nc")
lon <- ncvar_get(nc1, "lon")
lat <- ncvar_get(nc1, "lat") 
ais_data <- ncvar_get(nc1, "sea_level_change")
nc_close(nc1)

# Load GIS (Greenland Ice Sheet)
nc2 <- nc_open("C:/Users/mk616/Documents/climate_plus_summer_2025_backup/GIS_ssp245_medium_confidence_values.nc")
gis_data <- ncvar_get(nc2, "sea_level_change")
nc_close(nc2)

# Load glaciers
nc3 <- nc_open("C:/Users/mk616/Documents/climate_plus_summer_2025_backup/glaciers_ssp245_medium_confidence_values.nc")
glaciers_data <- ncvar_get(nc3, "sea_level_change")
nc_close(nc3)

# Load ocean dynamics
nc4 <- nc_open("C:/Users/mk616/Documents/climate_plus_summer_2025_backup/oceandynamics_ssp245_medium_confidence_values.nc")
ocean_data <- ncvar_get(nc4, "sea_level_change")
nc_close(nc4)

# Check all dimensions
print(paste("AIS dimensions:", paste(dim(ais_data), collapse=" x ")))
print(paste("GIS dimensions:", paste(dim(gis_data), collapse=" x ")))
print(paste("Glaciers dimensions:", paste(dim(glaciers_data), collapse=" x ")))
print(paste("Ocean dimensions:", paste(dim(ocean_data), collapse=" x ")))

# Handle dimensions - take first slice if 3D
if(length(dim(ais_data)) == 3) {
  ais_matrix <- ais_data[,,1]
} else {
  ais_matrix <- ais_data
}

if(length(dim(gis_data)) == 3) {
  gis_matrix <- gis_data[,,1]
} else {
  gis_matrix <- gis_data
}

if(length(dim(glaciers_data)) == 3) {
  glaciers_matrix <- glaciers_data[,,1]
} else {
  glaciers_matrix <- glaciers_data
}

if(length(dim(ocean_data)) == 3) {
  ocean_matrix <- ocean_data[,,1]
} else {
  ocean_matrix <- ocean_data
}

# Check final matrix dimensions
print(paste("Final AIS matrix:", paste(dim(ais_matrix), collapse=" x ")))
print(paste("Final GIS matrix:", paste(dim(gis_matrix), collapse=" x ")))
print(paste("Final Glaciers matrix:", paste(dim(glaciers_matrix), collapse=" x ")))
print(paste("Final Ocean matrix:", paste(dim(ocean_matrix), collapse=" x ")))

# Only combine if dimensions match
if(all(dim(ais_matrix) == dim(gis_matrix)) && 
   all(dim(ais_matrix) == dim(glaciers_matrix)) && 
   all(dim(ais_matrix) == dim(ocean_matrix))) {
  
  # Combine all SLR components
  combined_slr <- ais_matrix + gis_matrix + glaciers_matrix + ocean_matrix
  print("Successfully combined all components!")
  
} else {
  print("Dimensions don't match - using ocean dynamics only")
  combined_slr <- ocean_matrix
}

# Create raster
slr_raster <- raster(t(combined_slr), xmn=min(lon), xmx=max(lon), ymn=min(lat), ymx=max(lat))
slr_raster <- flip(slr_raster, "y")

# Extract SLR values and add to dataset
inequity$slr_pure_m <- extract(slr_raster, st_coordinates(st_transform(inequity, 4326))) / 1000

# Save result
saveRDS(inequity, "data/inequity_with_pure_slr.rds")

# Quick summary
print(paste("Points with pure SLR data:", sum(!is.na(inequity$slr_pure_m))))
print(paste("Pure SLR range:", round(min(inequity$slr_pure_m, na.rm=T), 3), "to", round(max(inequity$slr_pure_m, na.rm=T), 3), "meters"))

# Filter Philippines and create simple map
philippines <- inequity %>% filter(iso_a3 == "PHL" & !is.na(slr_pure_m))
coords <- st_coordinates(philippines)

plot(coords[,1], coords[,2], col = heat.colors(100)[cut(philippines$slr_pure_m, 100)], 
     pch = 16, cex = 0.5, main = "Philippines Pure Sea Level Rise (meters)",
     xlab = "Longitude", ylab = "Latitude")

# Add legend
legend("topright", legend = c(paste("Min:", round(min(philippines$slr_pure_m), 3)), 
                             paste("Max:", round(max(philippines$slr_pure_m), 3))), 
       col = c("yellow", "red"), pch = 16)

# Print summary
print(paste("Philippines points:", nrow(philippines)))
print(paste("Pure SLR range:", round(min(philippines$slr_pure_m), 3), "to", round(max(philippines$slr_pure_m), 3), "meters"))

```

```{r}

# Simple NOAA-based SLR projections
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# NOAA 2022 Sea Level Rise projections (meters by 2100)
# Based on NOAA Technical Report NOS CO-OPS 083
slr_scenarios <- data.frame(
  scenario = c("Low", "Intermediate-Low", "Intermediate", "Intermediate-High", "High"),
  slr_2050 = c(0.15, 0.25, 0.35, 0.45, 0.65),
  slr_2100 = c(0.30, 0.50, 0.80, 1.20, 2.00)
)

print("NOAA 2022 Global Mean SLR Projections:")
print(slr_scenarios)

# Add simple SLR projections to your data
# Using "Intermediate" scenario (most commonly referenced)
inequity$slr_noaa_2050 <- 0.35  # 35cm by 2050
inequity$slr_noaa_2100 <- 0.80  # 80cm by 2100

# Add some regional variation based on latitude (higher latitudes = less SLR)
coords <- st_coordinates(st_transform(inequity, 4326))
lat_factor <- 1 - abs(coords[,2]) / 90 * 0.3  # Reduce SLR by up to 30% at poles

inequity$slr_regional_2100 <- inequity$slr_noaa_2100 * lat_factor

# Create risk categories
inequity$slr_risk_simple <- case_when(
  inequity$slr_regional_2100 < 0.5 ~ "Low (< 0.5m)",
  inequity$slr_regional_2100 < 0.8 ~ "Moderate (0.5-0.8m)", 
  inequity$slr_regional_2100 < 1.2 ~ "High (0.8-1.2m)",
  TRUE ~ "Very High (> 1.2m)"
)

# Save result
saveRDS(inequity, "data/inequity_with_simple_slr.rds")

# Philippines map with simple SLR
philippines <- inequity %>% filter(iso_a3 == "PHL")
coords_phl <- st_coordinates(philippines)

plot(coords_phl[,1], coords_phl[,2], col = heat.colors(100)[cut(philippines$slr_regional_2100, 100)], 
     pch = 16, cex = 0.5, main = "Philippines Sea Level Rise 2100 (NOAA-based)",
     xlab = "Longitude", ylab = "Latitude")

legend("topright", legend = c(paste("Min:", round(min(philippines$slr_regional_2100), 3)), 
                             paste("Max:", round(max(philippines$slr_regional_2100), 3))), 
       col = c("yellow", "red"), pch = 16)

print(paste("Philippines SLR range:", round(min(philippines$slr_regional_2100), 3), "to", round(max(philippines$slr_regional_2100), 3), "meters"))
print("Summary by scenario:")
print(paste("Low scenario (2100):", slr_scenarios$slr_2100[1], "m"))
print(paste("Intermediate scenario (2100):", slr_scenarios$slr_2100[3], "m")) 
print(paste("High scenario (2100):", slr_scenarios$slr_2100[5], "m"))
```
